title: AI Process Audit intake
description: A structured description of a business and the processes it runs. This is the only input to the engine.

schema_version.description: Version of this intake schema the file was written against.

intake_id.description: Optional stable identifier for this intake, used to match gold labels in the eval harness.

collected_on.description: Date the intake was collected, as YYYY-MM-DD.

name.description: Trading name of the business. Optional so intakes can be anonymised.

industry.description: What the business does, in the words the business would use.

headcount.description: Total number of people, including part time and owners.

tools_in_use.description: Software the business already pays for or relies on, across the whole business.

notes.description: Anything about the business that does not fit the fields above.

id.description: Stable identifier for this process. Required in practice for gold labelling. Generated from the name if absent.

name.description: Short name for the process as staff would refer to it.

description.description: How the process runs today, start to finish, in order. Step inference reads this field, so ordering words such as then, next, and once are useful.

volume.description: How many items the process handles, and over what period.

count.description: Number of items. An estimate is fine and is expected.

unit.description: What is being counted, for example invoices, bookings, applications.

period.description: The period the count covers. Use per_run when the count is items handled each time the process runs.

is_estimate.description: True when the business guessed the number rather than reading it from a system.

roles.description: Job titles of the people involved. Used to attribute steps in the process map.

hours_per_run.description: Total person hours consumed each time the process runs, across everyone involved.

current_tools.description: Software and non software tools used in this specific process. Paper, phone, and whiteboard are valid entries.

pain_description.description: What goes wrong, what it costs, and who feels it. Scored directly by the pain criterion.

risk_flags.description: Optional. Properties of the process that raise implementation risk. Absent means none were reported, not that none exist.

data_notes.description: Optional. Where the information lives and what shape it is in. Read by the data availability criterion.

owner.description: Optional. The person accountable for the process.
